subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Should Feishu group sessions become account/app-scoped by default, and what migration or compatibility behavior should existing group sessions get?
rationale: The bug is source-backed and crosses session state, message routing, and bot identity boundaries, but changing group session keys affects persisted user state and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Account-scope with migration
options.body: Make Feishu group sessions include bot account/app identity by default and add doctor or runtime migration proof for existing persisted group keys.

options.title: Opt-in scoped mode first
options.body: Add an explicit Feishu group account-scoping mode so multi-bot deployments can isolate sessions without changing every existing group session immediately.

options.title: Document current contract
options.body: Keep group sessions shared by chat/topic/sender and document that multiple bot accounts in one Feishu group require separate agents or bindings.

recommendation.title: Account-scope with migration
recommendation.body: Make Feishu group sessions include bot account/app identity by default and add doctor or runtime migration proof for existing persisted group keys.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across Feishu docs/runtime and shared session-key routing helpers that shape this compatibility decision.
